decision.observation: Goose holds the boot before the closed back gate; latch hardware on the right post only sparkles when beaked. No NPC has ever appeared despite several honks with short waits.
decision.hypothesis: The groundskeeper beyond the gate may need sustained honking (repeated honks) and a long wait to walk over and open the gate; this has never been properly tested.
decision.memory: Gate resistant to all beak/drag attempts; NPC arrival unverified beyond ~4s waits.
